Three Separate Road Accidents Reported in Hisar, Una, and on Highway

Three distinct road accidents occurred in different locations. In Hisar, a truck struck a scooty from behind while a father and son were returning home after completing KYC work, resulting in the father's death and the son's injury. On the Amb-Una highway in Una, a collision between two cars left a 70-year-old father dead, while his son and two young children were injured. In a third incident, a driver was killed on a highway after being struck from behind by a speeding vehicle while he was changing a punctured tire on a pickup truck.
